title: WiFi Icon
drDigitalIntro:
The WiFi icon in the menu bar shows whether you are connected to the internet.
• A solid icon means you are connected. A faded or crossed-out icon means you are not.
• Click it to see a list of nearby networks and which one you are connected to (shown with a checkmark).
• If you ever lose internet, this is the first place to look.
• On a real computer, you can also turn WiFi on and off from this panel.

playgroundTask.goal: Use the WiFi panel to disconnect and reconnect

steps.say: Click the WiFi icon in the menu bar.
Click Disconnect next to CoolKids Network.

drDigitalSuccess: You opened the WiFi panel, disconnected, and connected again. That panel is where you go when a page will not load.
drDigitalHint: Look in the top-right of the menu bar for the WiFi icon (it looks like curved lines). Click it to open the panel.
